title: Traditional British Yorkshire Pudding
description: A classic British side dish, Yorkshire pudding is a simple yet impressive accompaniment to roast beef. This recipe yields a crispy, golden-brown pudding with a satisfying texture.
instructions: Place a 12-cup muffin tin in the oven to heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, eggs, milk, salt, and pepper.
Remove the muffin tin from the oven and add a small amount of beef drippings to each cup.
Pour the batter into each cup, filling about 2/3 full.
Return the muffin tin to the oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the puddings are golden brown and puffed.
